name: Mayoi no Kalanchoe
source:
"―――Everything, every last damn thing, just feels... wrong."

Inunashi Mamoru mutters these words as he heads back to Mayunoha Town, a location tucked away in the heart of Taishou-era Japan. The simple life he once knew with his mother has been turned upside down by her sudden disappearance.

Suddenly, a letter from his father, who's only known through stories, arrives. It bears harsh news: his mother's death and details of her funeral in their forsaken hometown.

[b]"Come back to the place you left behind,"[/b] the letter seems to dare.

Caught in a whirl of confusion and fear, Mamoru is compelled to return, holding onto this singular lead.

The small town is a strange mix of the familiar and the unknown, where encounters with old faces and new figures will set the wheels of change in motion.

"......Why........................"

A hoarse voice of a woman signals the start of a tragedy as death comes knocking at the inn known as [i]Kaerazu no Yakata[/i] (Mansion of No Return). Mamoru's return to Mayunoha Town has awakened the once-sleeping gears of fate, like blood surging through long-dormant veins.

In this world, the dead stay dead—a truth as inevitable as any curse.

[b]"Ah, let's orchestrate the chaos. Cue the puppet dance of this grand masquerade,"[/b] the demon laughs.

The curtain of tragedy has been raised, and there is no turning back―

[Translated and edited from [url=https://shikobisoft.vercel.app/mayukara]the official website[/url]]
